verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice stores customer cards to charge recurring transactions automatically, so card lifecycle management is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no network account updater, no backup payment methods, and no hosted update-payment page. Card storage and the transaction-viewing customer portal are adjacent features, not self-updating cards.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages
